en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hajjal, from Dawood Bin Abu Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

And in another report, ‘(He<sup>asws</sup> said): ‘And that is because his good deeds ascend to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, therefore he is not publicised among the people, and the disbeliever is appreciated’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hajjal from Dawud ibn abu Yazid from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
It is narrated in another Hadith : ‘This is because the virtues of a believer are taken to Allah, thus, they do not spread among the people and an unbeliever is appreciated.’”
